description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Enamaluwa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matake District (24/1216)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels with ownership details, extent measurements, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership determinations, property registrations, and title settlements for specific plots of land in designated locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
